BWS.Settings.SheetIntegration.Name: Character Sheet Integration
BWS.Settings.SheetIntegration.Hint: Inject an animation configuration button into spell rows on the PF2e character sheet. Only visible while JB2A and Sargas Visual Automation are both active.
BWS.Settings.SidebarButton.Name: Show Toolbar Button
BWS.Settings.SidebarButton.Hint: Add a spellbook button to the scene controls toolbar on the left of the canvas.
BWS.Settings.FolderName.Name: Spellbook Folder Name
BWS.Settings.FolderName.Hint: Name of the Journal Entry folder that stores every spellbook.
BWS.Settings.LootFolderName.Name: Loot Spellbook Folder Name
BWS.Settings.LootFolderName.Hint: Name of the Item folder that stores generated loot spellbooks.
BWS.Settings.LootProfile.Name: Default Loot Book Size
BWS.Settings.LootProfile.Hint: Which book shape the loot generator starts on.
BWS.Settings.LootMaxRarity.Name: Loot Rarity Ceiling
BWS.Settings.LootMaxRarity.Hint: Rarest spell a generated loot spellbook may contain.
BWS.Settings.TrackLearned.Name: Track Learned Spells
BWS.Settings.TrackLearned.Hint: Record on the book which characters have already copied each spell out of it.
BWS.Settings.ConsumeOnLearn.Name: Spend Pages On Learning
BWS.Settings.ConsumeOnLearn.Hint: Once a character learns a spell from a book, that page is spent for them. Other readers are unaffected and the book is never destroyed.
BWS.Creator.NotEditable: That book holds crafting formulas, which the spellbook creator cannot edit.
BWS.Creator.KindSwitchCleared: Selection cleared: a book holds either spells or rituals, not both.
BWS.Creator.RankAllHint: All ranks (shift-click a rank to select a range)
BWS.Creator.SelectedEmpty: No spells selected yet. Tick a spell to add it to this book.
BWS.Creator.OwnershipNote: Saved with OWNER for you and every GM
BWS.Creator.ReadOnlyNote: You do not have permission to edit this spellbook.
BWS.Creator.StorageNote: Storage only - no casting from this window
BWS.Creator.NoResultsHint: Try a different tradition or rank, clear the search, or enable focus spells.
BWS.Ritual.SelectedEmpty: No rituals selected yet. Tick a ritual to add it to this book.
BWS.Formula.NoTarget: Select a token or assign a character to copy formulas.
BWS.Formula.Teach: Copy this formula to the crafter
BWS.Formula.TeachAllTooltip: Copy every formula this crafter does not already know
BWS.Formula.NothingToTeach: {actor} already knows every formula in this book.
BWS.Formula.NotACrafter: {actor} is not a character, so it cannot learn crafting formulas.
BWS.Formula.NotAFormulaBook: That book does not hold crafting formulas.
BWS.Formula.ReaderNote: Copying a formula adds it to the crafter's own formula list. The book is not consumed.
BWS.Browser.Title: My Spellbooks
BWS.Browser.EmptyHint: Create your first spellbook to collect spells from the compendiums and send them straight into a character's slots.
BWS.Browser.DeleteConfirm: Delete the spellbook "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
BWS.Browser.DeleteLootConfirm: Delete the loot spellbook "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
BWS.Slot.Title: Send to Slot
BWS.Slot.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character before sending a spell to a slot.
BWS.Slot.NotOwner: You do not have ownership of {actor}, so spells cannot be sent to them.
BWS.Slot.NoEntries: {actor} has no spellcasting entries. Add one on the character sheet first.
BWS.Slot.RitualRefused: {spell} is a ritual. PF2e casts rituals outside spell slots, so it cannot be sent to a spellcasting entry.
BWS.Slot.NoFreeSlot: {entry} has no free slot left in {rank}. {spell} was added to the entry but not prepared.
BWS.Slot.NotPrepared: {spell} was added to {entry} but could not be prepared ({rank}).
BWS.Slot.NoRankAvailable: {entry} has no slot at any rank that can hold this spell.
BWS.Import.ButtonTooltip: Build a book from the spells, rituals or formulas a character already has
BWS.Import.SheetButton: Import this character's spells, rituals or formulas into a book
BWS.Import.UnlinkedTooltip: No compendium spell matches this one, so the book points at this character's own copy.
BWS.Import.UnlinkedNote: {count} entr(ies) matched no compendium and will be stored against this character's own copy.
BWS.Import.RitualNote: {count} ritual(s) were left out: a spellbook holds spells that can fill a slot. Switch to Rituals to collect them.
BWS.Import.MissingNote: {count} formula(s) point at items that are no longer installed and were skipped.
BWS.Import.KindMismatch: That book holds a different kind of entry.
BWS.Import.ReadOnlyNote: Reads the sheet only - nothing is added to or removed from the character.
BWS.Import.Merged: Added {count} entries to "{name}" - {skipped} were already there.
BWS.Import.NothingSelected: Tick at least one row to import.
BWS.Import.NoActors.spells: No character you own has any spells to import.
BWS.Import.NoActors.rituals: No character you own has any rituals to import.
BWS.Import.NoActors.formulas: No character you own has any crafting formulas to import.
BWS.Import.Empty.formulas: No crafting formulas on this sheet
BWS.Import.EmptyHint.spells: Add spells to a spellcasting entry on the character sheet, then import them here.
BWS.Import.EmptyHint.rituals: Add rituals on the Rituals sub-tab of the character sheet's Spellcasting tab, or build a ritual book from the compendiums instead.
BWS.Import.EmptyHint.formulas: Add formulas on the character sheet's crafting tab, then import them here.
BWS.Anim.Title: Animation
BWS.Anim.Hint: Plays on the caster when this spell is cast from the character sheet. Saved as a Sargas Visual Automation recipe on the spell, so the Animation button on the spell sheet can refine it further.
BWS.Anim.Unavailable: JB2A and Sargas Visual Automation must both be active to edit animations.
BWS.Notify.NoName: Enter a name for the spellbook before saving.
BWS.Notify.NoSpells: Select at least one spell before saving.
BWS.Notify.NoPermission: You do not have permission to edit this spellbook.
BWS.Error.QueryFailed: Failed to read spells from the compendiums.
BWS.Error.FolderFailed: Failed to create the spellbook folder.
BWS.Error.NoJournalCreate: Your user role cannot create journal entries, so a new book cannot be saved. A GM can grant "Create Journal Entries" to your role in User Management.
BWS.Error.SlotFailed: Failed to send the spell to the actor.
BWS.Error.SpellMissing: That spell could not be loaded from its compendium.
BWS.Error.ImportFailed: Failed to read that character sheet.
BWS.Error.FormulaAddFailed: Failed to add the formula to that character.
BWS.Error.AnimSaveFailed: Failed to save the animation path.
BWS.Loot.Title: Spellbook Generator
BWS.Loot.RollTooltip: Generate a random spellbook for a chosen tradition
BWS.Loot.SourcesTooltip: Choose which books the roll may draw spells from
BWS.Loot.NoSources: No spell sources found in your compendiums.
BWS.Loot.Shortfall: The compendiums could not supply {count} more spells at these settings.
BWS.Loot.EmptyRollHint: No spell in your compendiums matches these settings. Try a lower rarity ceiling, another tradition, or a higher level.
BWS.Loot.ReaderNote: Learning copies the spell into one of your spellcasting entries. The book is not consumed.
BWS.Loot.NoTarget: Select a token or assign a character to learn from this book.
BWS.Loot.NotALootBook: That item is not a loot spellbook.
BWS.Loot.NoReplacement: No other spell of that rank is available at these settings.
BWS.Loot.NothingRolled: Roll a book before creating the item.
BWS.Loot.GMOnly: Only a GM can create a loot spellbook in the world.
BWS.Loot.CreateFailed: Failed to create the loot spellbook.
BWS.Loot.RollFailed: Failed to roll a loot spellbook.
BWS.Loot.ItemBlurb: A {tradition} spellbook holding {count} spells. Open it to copy a spell into a spellcasting entry.
BWS.Loot.ProfileHint.traveler: A few spells, none at the very top of its level.
BWS.Loot.ProfileHint.grimoire: A working spellbook of moderate size.
BWS.Loot.ProfileHint.archmage: A large collection leaning on its highest ranks.
